source: 시안 — 저장소를 만들기 전(2026-10-30) 손으로 쓴 지시문. 설계표(traits·worlds)의 바탕이 됐다
prompt:
CONCEPT: a citizen of the Gold Nation — the nation of the element of wealth, permanence and light: warm, unchanging, proud. Each citizen is a personification of one substance or use of that element.
CITIZEN: GOLD COIN (the past). A female personification character with a stamped gold coin as her motif — the coin reimagined as a woman in cloth and ornament that carry its materials, colors, shape and motifs: round disc shapes as a crown and earrings, embossed lion-head relief as a brooch, warm yellow gold with deep amber shadow, fine stamped-edge borders along her hems, electrum-pale hair. She does NOT hold a coin; it is not a separate object. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ERA: THE PAST — the Kingdom of Lydia around 600 BC, the city of Sardis where the first coins were struck: a stone mint courtyard with an anvil die and a furnace, limestone columns, the river Pactolus with its gold sand glittering, dry sunlit Anatolian hills. Costume follows the Lydian / Ionian Greek period exactly: a long chiton and himation in gold-dyed linen with wool, period jewelry; no fantasy magic, no modern material.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
